name: MobileBuildMCP (formerly XcodeBuildMCP)
summary: Sentry's MCP server and CLI for iOS and macOS work: agents build, run and test Xcode projects on simulators and devices; formerly XcodeBuildMCP.
description: One package gives both a CLI (`mobilebuildmcp`) and an MCP server (`mobilebuildmcp mcp`, or `npx -y mobilebuildmcp@latest mcp` without installing). Install with Homebrew (`brew tap getsentry/xcodebuildmcp && brew install mobilebuildmcp`) or npm. `mobilebuildmcp init` installs two optional Agent Skills that teach agents the MCP tools or the CLI. Requires macOS 14.5+, Xcode 16+ and Node.js 18+ (not for Homebrew); device tools need code signing set up in Xcode. Sends runtime error telemetry to Sentry, with an opt-out. The old `xcodebuildmcp` npm package and xcodebuildmcp.com now point to the new name.
